name: Next
description: Take the next step in your professional growth and build the forward-thinking skills needed to thrive in an evolving world. Through practical insights and actionable strategies, this course prepares you to confidently navigate change and excel in whatever comes next.

name: AI Automation
description: Master the fundamentals of AI-driven automation to streamline workflows, integrate large language models, and build intelligent software agents. Learn to leverage APIs, low-code tools, and custom scripts to automate complex business processes efficiently.
